title: Knowledge Gateway MCP — Shared Enums
description: Phase 0 contract-only. status/freshness/verification are three separate, non-collapsible dimensions per docs/plans/knowledge-gateway-mcp-proposal.md §12/§13 — never merge them into one confidence-style field. statement_classification is the §13 FACT/INFERENCE/DECISION vocabulary. All four enums are a new, separate vocabulary — disjoint from tools/validate_frontmatter.py's STATUS_VALUES/AUTHORITY_VALUES and docs/parity_ledger/schema.json's status/priority enums.
